note: The result assembly of the OSCAL 1.2.1 assessment-results model. Every result is required to declare the controls it reviewed, so the control frame is unavoidable at the result level. The referenced reviewed-controls assembly requires control-selections, and a selection may use include-all rather than naming individual controls, so the requirement can be met without listing any one control.
fragment_note: Only required and the reviewed-controls property are carried. The other properties of result are not relevant to this claim and are omitted.
